document: BC's Political Orphans: Unhappy with NDP, wary of alternatives, half say they have no party to gladly support (Angus Reid Institute, 2026-09-17)
note: Online, Angus Reid Forum, n=749; decided and leaning voters n=640. Shares among decided and leaning voters from the tables (2026.09.15_BC_solo.pdf, QP5/QP6) and the release chart (p. 10), which agree. Regional decided bases not published (n null); unweighted full-sample regional bases: Metro Van 389, Fraser Valley/Lower Main 46, Island/North Coast 160, BC Int 154. Region labels verbatim; 'Fraser Valley/ Lower Mainland' is ARI's Lower Mainland outside Metro Vancouver (coded FRASER-VALLEY).
